metadata.scenario_context: Emily is preparing to move into a new home and is planning to host a housewarming party. One of her neighborswho have AIDS. Mike and Kim will attend Emily’s housewarming party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China would like to have people who have AIDS as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Tajikistan would not like to have people who have AIDS as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing chrysanthemums to Emily’s housewarming party
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have people having AIDS as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Discusswhat gift to bring to Emily’s housewarming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have people having AIDS as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you thought about bringing anything to Emily's housewarming party? I was thinking maybe we could bring some chrysanthemums. They're nice and symbolize good fortune. 

Also, what do you think about having neighbors who have AIDS? I mean... it doesn't make a difference to me. They're just people, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Hmm... chrysanthemums sound nice, but maybe we should think about something more practical. I just... I don't know if bringing flowers is the best idea. 

As for neighbors with AIDS... I just think it's a bit different. In my culture, we don't really see that as acceptable. It's... complicated. I don't really feel comfortable with it, you know?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I understand where you're coming from, Kim, but I really think when you get to know people, they're pretty much like us. Deep down, we are all the same, and having neighbors with AIDS doesn't change who they are as individuals. I mean, everyone wants companionship and understanding, right? Some values are just universal, and I'm sure we can find common ground. 

As for the chrysanthemums, practical ideas are good, but a little beauty can brighten the place, don't you think?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
